name: What is the typical process for ceiling repair with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for ceiling repair with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our typical ceiling repair process begins with an initial inspection to assess the damage and identify its cause. We then provide a detailed estimate and plan for the repair. The work usually involves preparing the area, repairing or replacing damaged sections, texturing to match existing surfaces, and finally, painting. Throughout the process, we prioritize clear communication and minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ceiling repair process includes an inspection, detailed estimate, repair of damaged sections, re-texturing, and painting, with clear communication throughout.
